decisions.reason: As the flagship platform that defines the firm's strategic direction and anchors its integrated geospatial offer, it meets aspirations in a growing industry and gives no trigger for problemistic search to drop it.

Mobile field data capture is close to the core offer and kept its own page across years, so with organisational slack from industry growth the firm can carry it despite uncertain results, though there is some risk it gets folded into the platform.

Unlike the dropped small plugins, the search extension showed active versioning and remained on its own page, which indicates satisfactory performance relative to aspirations and fits the platform ecosystem, so keeping it is the satisficing choice.
